author: HahaBub
body:
Username: BubsterYT and when i played on you're server in 2013 Bubster9998
Why I was banned: A person I have on skype we traded accounts and we both changed details because he was hacking on my account and he gave it to another person. I was logging on your
server and realized i was banned perm for "Ban Evading of xXMineslishXx". Where he has a different account then me. On my stats on bubster9998 I've had alot of kills and called a hacker alot because of me being super good at the bow.

I should be unbanned: I wan't to be unbanned so I can record videos of my favorite game of Nebula, It's how I got into minecraft PvP and strategy. I don't want to be banned from the only good server with nebula.Through 2013-14 I played almost everyday I had a chance to. I don't want to alt because of a skype friend who hacks to steal my enjoyment of your server. I was banned falsely and xXMineslishXx should recieve the punishment not me. I don't hack or anything the only mod I use is optifine. When my little brother went on an alt to play because he forgot the password to his account he was banned so he questioned it. I've not been on an alt to play on your server. The amount of time I've server since the ban was 1 month and 2 weeks.
